side.description: Side of the trigger the card is placed on.

align.description: Alignment of the card relative to the trigger.

offset.description: Distance in pixels between the card and the trigger.

portalTo.description: Where the card is teleported to in the DOM.

collisionPadding.description: Padding (in pixels) kept between the card and the viewport edges when repositioning to avoid collisions.

hoverDelay.description: Delay (in seconds) from when the pointer enters the trigger until the card opens. Matches the Tooltip convention of using seconds.

leaveDelay.description: Delay (in seconds) from when the pointer leaves the trigger or card until the card closes.

arrow.description: Render a small arrow pointing at the trigger. Styled to match the panel surface.
